articles.title: Singapore’s DayOne pauses U.S. IPO plans amid AI market volatility - Bloomberg
articles.summary: Investing.com-- Singapore-based data center operator DayOne Data Centers has put its plans for a multibillion-dollar U.S. initial public offering on hold as investor concerns over lofty valuations and volatility in AI-related stocks weigh on the sector, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: BNP Paribas plans fewer branches and pivot to wealthier clients at BNL unit
articles.summary: Under plan, the subsidiary is pivoting its priorities towards corporate banking, private banking, and wealth management.

articles.title: BNP Paribas’ BNL targets over 20% return on equity by 2030 in strategy shift
articles.summary: Investing.com -- BNP Paribas’ (EPA:BNPP) Italian unit BNL aims to raise its pre-tax return on notional equity to more than 20% by 2030 by shifting its focus from mass-market retail banking towards wealth management, private and corporate banking, while keeping cost growth below inflation and reducing risk-weighted assets, the French bank said on Wednesday.
